name: taskforge-root
description: TaskForge - Monorepo root runner for Express API Gateway, BullMQ Worker, and Next.js Client

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,WORKER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run worker:dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
